title: D&F 6.3.10 — An outer automorphism of S6
header:
Dummit–Foote, §6.3, exercise 10, printed p. 221 (PDF p. 235); Coxeter presentation in Example 5, printed p. 219. Week 9 lecture notes, PDF pp. 10–11, discuss presentations and Coxeter groups.
